target_bssid.description: BSSID of the target Access Point.

interface_name.description: Name of the wireless interface in monitor mode.

essid.description: ESSID of the target AP. Empty string means omit this argument.

host_mac.description: MAC address of the host system. Empty string means omit this argument.

pin.description: Specific WPS PIN to attempt. Empty string means omit this argument.

output_file.description: File path for log output. Empty string means stdout.
